key_insight: In finite systems, the Zakharov–Filonenko capillary-wave energy-cascade spectrum spans a limited dynamic range that shrinks with decreasing average steepness, consistent with ∼μ^(8/3) scaling.
engineering_relevance: Finite-domain capillary-wave simulations must account for wave steepness when interpreting how broadly an energy-cascade spectrum can develop.
method: Numerically simulate capillary-wave turbulence in finite systems.
Evaluate the cascade spectrum across nonlinearity levels.
Test dynamic-range scaling with average wave steepness.
evidence_signal: The simulations confirm the proposed ∼μ^(8/3) scaling and show the Zakharov–Filonenko spectrum over a reported record dynamic range close to or beyond one decade across multiple configurations.
watch_item: The abstract provides numerical evidence but does not specify resolution, uncertainty estimates, or experimental validation.
paper_title: Wave Turbulence of Capillary Waves in Finite Systems
